project: Ship of Ethereon V2 / Lumina OS bootstrap
purpose: Classify quantum-adjacent terms so the project can use quantum-inspired language without overclaiming literal physics or allowing symbolic terms to become load-bearing governance law.

psi42_transceiver_v16.public_summary: A quantum-inspired classical signal transceiver for testing continuity under noise, drift, and recomposition.
psi42_transceiver_v16.authority_boundary: Experimental expressive instrument only; may not own canon, governance, mode legality, checkpoint legality, or primary continuity authority.

terms.scientific_meaning: A quantum state expressed as a linear combination of basis states.
terms.ethereon_usage: A set of unresolved candidate branches before selection.
forbidden_claims: Candidate branches are literal quantum states

terms.scientific_meaning: Informal label for measurement-associated transition in quantum-state descriptions depending on interpretation.
terms.ethereon_usage: Branch selection after evaluating candidates against a declared basis.
forbidden_claims: Runtime selection is literal quantum collapse
Collapse authorizes governance or canon mutation

terms.scientific_meaning: A measurement interaction or experimental frame, not necessarily a conscious mind.

forbidden_claims: Human consciousness is required for physical collapse

terms.classification: metaphor unless literal physics is under discussion

terms.scientific_meaning: Stable phase relationship or preserved quantum/signal relationship depending on domain.
